title: Dangles a refund or cashback
why: A 'refund' that needs your PIN, a QR scan or an app is a way to take money. 'Sent by mistake, please return it' is another common trick.
examples: Your refund is ready, verify your card details to claim it now.
I sent Rs 5000 to your number by mistake, please send it back urgently.
safe: Refund of Rs 200 initiated for order 12345. It will reflect in 5-7 working days.
Your cashback of Rs 20 has been credited to your wallet.
